lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec precondition names an absence before any successful initialization test every database state that phrase admits no schema at all and schema without seed not just the most convenient one
lessons.text: When a spec precondition names an absence ("before any successful initialization"), test every database state that phrase admits - no schema at all, and schema without seed - not just the most convenient one.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the spec requires an error response to carry named fields without fixing their wording assert each field is present and non empty and record the missing wording as a spec precision gap
lessons.text: When the spec requires an error response to carry named fields without fixing their wording, assert each field is present and non-empty and record the missing wording as a spec-precision gap.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::name the exact http status code in the spec for every refusal path when the spec only says explicit error record the chosen status as a spec precision gap instead of passing it silently
lessons.text: Name the exact HTTP status code in the spec for every refusal path; when the spec only says "explicit error", record the chosen status as a spec-precision gap instead of passing it silently.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::duckdb checks foreign keys immediately and cannot defer them within a transaction so a schema needing single transaction delete and reinsert must declare relationships as documented logical foreign keys instead of references
lessons.text: DuckDB checks foreign keys immediately and cannot defer them within a transaction, so a schema needing single-transaction delete-and-reinsert must declare relationships as documented logical foreign keys instead of REFERENCES.
